English / 简体中文

Windows x64 installer and portable executable. English + Chinese application; seven-language illustrated website.

Highlights: normal/accelerated color modes, three draggable quota consumption tracks, moving red forecast pace and glowing deadline range, five-source monitoring, historical provenance comparison, and persistent grouped reset alerts. Promotional images use synthetic data. Forecasts are references, not guarantees.

安装版与便携版均支持 Windows x64，软件中英双语。支持常规/加速模式、三条可拖动额度节奏、动态红色游泳线与荧光范围、五源预告检测、历史来源比对和持续合并通知。预告仅供参考，宣传图片为虚构演示数据。

Personal quota requires the official Codex CLI signed in locally. Public monitoring needs no dashboard account. Settings remain in the Windows profile, including portable use. Binaries are currently unsigned; SHA256SUMS.txt lets you verify downloads.

个人额度需本机官方 Codex CLI 已登录；公开监控无需额外账户。便携版设置仍保存在用户目录。发行包尚未签名，可用 SHA256SUMS.txt 核对文件。

GPL-3.0-only; corresponding source is available through this tag’s source archives. See README and PRIVACY.md.
